declared: 2026-11-07, before the frozen rustc 1.98.0 oracle of these exact bytes. The drafts' lang-item and feature prerequisites (a `not` lang item for `!b`, u32 Copy, literal rather than range patterns) were settled against rustc 1.98.0 in obj/parallel/census-batch7/repro first; each outcome follows the stated rule (CTFE executes `assume` itself, never its fallback body), not that exploration

assume-true-length.rs.reason: core's exact `assume` declaration and fallback body; a const fn assumes a true condition before returning the array length 3

assert-unchecked-length.rs.reason: core's `hint::assert_unchecked` shape calls `assume` on a condition over a source ctpop result, which is the ilog10 path in core

associated-buffer-length.rs.reason: core's NumBufferTrait shape: an impl's associated type and associated const both use a length that reaches assert_unchecked

bodiless-assume-length.rs.reason: a bodiless `assume` intrinsic declaration assumes a true condition in an anonymous length block

assume-length-mismatch.rs.reason: opponent: the assumed-true length is 3, so a [u8; 3] is not [u8; 4] (E0308)

assume-false-length.rs.reason: opponent: the condition is false, which is undefined behavior, so constant evaluation fails (E0080)

empty-fallback-false.rs.reason: opponent: the fallback body is empty and would accept, but CTFE executes `assume` itself, so a false condition still fails (E0080)
